## Podcasts, like on Spotify
- **Search:** shows and episodes appear below the music, with their own **Podcasts & Shows** and **Episodes** filters. A show whose name you type is the top result
- **Podcasts page** (Browse all → Podcasts): continue listening, your shows, new episodes, the top podcasts of your country and categories
- **Show page:** cover, About, all episodes (newest or oldest first, 50 at a time), Follow, play the newest episode
- **Episode page:** full description, date, length, mark as played
- **Follow shows:** they appear in Your Library (new **Podcasts** tab) and in the sidebar, in Green with the **Podcasts & Shows** chip
- **Picks up where you stopped:** every episode remembers its position on every device, shows the time left and a progress bar, or **Played** once finished
- **Player for episodes:** playback speed 0.5× to 3×, 15 seconds back and forward, sleep timer (minutes or end of episode), on the computer, the phone and the media keys. Songs always keep 1×
- **New episodes by themselves:** the server checks every followed show every 3 minutes (cheap, only when the feed changed). A new episode shows up in the open app within a minute, with a note, and a blue dot on the show until you open it
- **Green:** episode rows, buttons and the now playing panel (episode description, About the show with Follow) like Spotify
- Shows and charts from the public Apple Podcasts directory, episodes from each show's own feed, the sound streamed through your server (seeking and the equalizer work)

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Windows / Linux:** nothing to install, the apps pick it up from the server
- **Android:** update the app once (Settings → Updates) so playback speed also works in the phone player
